context_requirements: Expression of functional CB1 (CNR1) and/or CB2 (CNR2) receptors; prostate lines PC3 and VCAP express higher cannabinoid receptor levels than normal prostate epithelium
Intact downstream ERK1/2 and PI3K/AKT signalling to transduce receptor activation into transcriptional and cell-cycle effects
Proliferating cells with intact G1/S machinery (cyclin D/E, CDK2/4/6, RB) for arrest to be observable
Immune-lineage or high-CB2 cells for the apoptotic/immunosuppressive arm; most adherent carcinoma lines have low CB2
falsifiers: No change in any of CCND1, CDKN1A, MYC, FOS or EGR1 at 6 h or 24 h in PC3 or VCAP at 10 micromolar
Absence of any proliferation_down or g1_arrest signature at 24 h in the prostate lines
No dose- or receptor-dependence: responses identical in lines lacking CNR1/CNR2 expression
Strong interferon or unfolded_protein_response signature dominating instead of cell-cycle/apoptotic changes

evidence.supports: WIN-55,212-2 (1-10 micromolar, 24 h) arrests LNCaP and PC3 prostate cancer cells in G0/G1, induces p53 and p27/KIP1, and down-regulates cyclins D1/D2/E, CDK2/4/6, E2F1-4 and RB
Anandamide inhibits mitogen-induced T and B lymphocyte proliferation and induces apoptosis, with rapid onset of DNA synthesis inhibition
CB2-selective agonist JWH-015 triggers caspase-8/9/3-dependent apoptosis in thymocytes and inhibits T/B cell proliferation
WIN55,212-2 modulates PI3K/AKT signalling and downstream CREB, BAD, GSK-3beta and FOXO3A in vivo
WIN55,212-2 suppresses neuronal apoptosis via inhibition of JNK signalling and modulation of Bcl-2/Bax/caspase-3
